import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(["git", "checkout", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("Checkout HEAD:", result.stdout[:200])
result = subprocess.run(["python", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-x", "-p", "no:cacheprovider",

    "tests/test_formatter.py", "tests/test_locales.py", "tests/test_parser.py", 
    "tests/test_util.py"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("Exit code:", result.returncode)
# Count failures
lines = result.stdout.split('\n')
for line in lines:
    if 'FAILED' in line or 'failed' in line.lower() or 'passed' in line.lower():
        print(line)
